Australian Bureau of Statist: Census of Population and Housing - Counts of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, 2021
Table 1: Census counts, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander persons, Australia, 1971-2021
Data is based on place of usual residence. Excludes overseas visitors.
(a) Indigenous status was reported as 'Aboriginal origin'. Between 1971 and 1981, Indigenous status was reported as 'Racial origin'.
(b) Includes Other Territories from 1996 onwards - Jervis Bay, Cocos (Keeling) Islands and Christmas Island. In 2016, Norfolk Island was added to Other Territories.
(c) The standard Indigenous Question was introduced in 1996.

Please note that there are small random adjustments made to all cell values to protect the confidentiality of data. These adjustments may cause the sum of rows or columns to differ by small amounts from table totals.
